features.name: Calculate CO2 in Sustainability Journal
features.description: New action in sustainability journal that uses copilot to calculate emissions automatically. Copilot identifies emission factors from uploaded Excel files or public sources and performs calculations.
caveats: Requires at least basic input data such as liters of fuel or kilometers traveled
Excel files should be cleaned to contain only relevant data, not thousands of lines

features.name: Emission Factor Lookup from Multiple Sources
features.description: Copilot attempts to find emission factors first from uploaded Excel files in the system, then falls back to public sources if not found locally.

features.name: Emission Source Setup Page
features.description: New page where users can upload Excel files containing emission factors. Supports multiple files per company for different countries, machines, or data sources.
caveats: Excel files should contain only necessary information
Large files with thousands of lines may cause performance issues

features.name: Date-based Emission Factor Versioning
features.description: Users can specify starting and ending dates for emission factors in Excel files, allowing different factor versions for different periods. System maintains full audit history of all versions.

features.name: Calculation Explanation Details
features.description: Users can drill down into copilot-suggested results to view the full calculation breakdown, including formula, intermediate values, and final emission results for verification.

features.name: Keep Emission Factor Results
features.description: Users can choose to save specific emission factors from copilot suggestions to the system for reuse in future calculations, reducing need for copilot lookups.

features.name: Calculate Emissions Without Complete Data
features.description: Core capability allowing users to calculate emissions even when emission factors are not available, as long as basic data like fuel consumption or distance is provided.
